findings.title: Missing value is dereferenced before null check
findings.description: The priority field is accessed without first checking whether it is None. When a caller omits the field the expression raises an AttributeError.
findings.evidence: priority_value = data.priority.lower()  # data.priority may be None
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit null guard before dereferencing: `if data.priority is not None`.

findings.title: Status field is not validated against allowed values
findings.description: The status field is stored without checking that it is one of the permitted enum values, allowing arbitrary strings to reach the data store.
findings.recommendation: Validate against an explicit allowlist before storing, or use a Pydantic enum field in the request model.

limitations: Did not analyse third-party library code.
